summary_en: TOA Corporation raised interim dividend to 42.50 yen per share from 38.50 yen for the half-year ended September 30, 2026, and revised full-year dividend forecast to 85.00 yen from 77.00 yen, driven by improved profitability in domestic construction projects and steady backlog performance.
title_en: Notice regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast and Interim Dividend Payment and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
TOA Corporation announced an interim dividend increase and a revision to its full-year dividend forecast on November 10, 2026. The interim dividend per share for the half-year ended September 30, 2026 was increased to 42.50 yen from the previously forecasted 42.50 yen. The full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 was revised upward to 85.00 yen per share, comprising an interim dividend of 42.50 yen and a year-end dividend of 42.50 yen, compared to the prior forecast of 77.00 yen (interim 38.50 yen, year-end 38.50 yen).

The dividend increases reflect significant upward revisions to consolidated and standalone earnings forecasts announced simultaneously. The company raised its consolidated net income forecast for fiscal 2027 by 2.0 billion yen to 16.5 billion yen, driven primarily by individual segment performance improvements. In the domestic construction business, profitability on major projects improved substantially. Domestic civil engineering and overseas operations maintained strong backlog performance, which supported margin expansion. Consolidated operating profit was raised by 3.6 billion yen to 24.7 billion yen, and ordinary profit by 3.5 billion yen to 24.3 billion yen.

The interim dividend totaled 3,477 million yen with an ex-dividend date of September 30, 2026 and an effective date of December 4, 2026. The dividend was funded from retained earnings.
